short_description: Find and use the right Evercraft capability from one connected front door.
long_description: Evercraft is a problem-first front door into the Evercraft/Systemia capability fabric. It matches a real-world goal to the smallest truthful Evercraft capability, prefers a verified specialist route when one exists, preserves evidence and availability boundaries, and keeps private context, payments, publishing, deployment and other consequential actions behind the applicable authorization and explicit human confirmation.
release_notes: Evercraft v1.0.3 aligns portable and compatibility metadata for public OpenAI submission on the verified Evercraft-owned Fabric MCP. Discovery remains read-only and consequential actions retain separate authorization.
starter_prompts: I have a problem and do not know which Evercraft capability fits. Find the smallest useful option.
I have a video that's too large for this chat. What can handle it?
Find me a service for a discontinued machine part I cannot locate.
I want to evaluate whether my property is a good EV charging site.
My small-business website is slow and not converting. What can audit it?
I need sourced research on a land, water or resilience problem.
Our developer disappeared and our existing app is breaking. We need an evidence-first diagnosis before rebuilding.
remaining_platform_prerequisites: Upload the canonical Evercraft v1.0.3 ZIP in OpenAI Platform Plugins
Select the verified Evercraft LLC developer identity in the owning organization/project
Confirm Apps Management Write access if the submitter is not an organization owner
Complete the portal-generated domain verification challenge for fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com
Complete the current portal MCP connection and Scan Tools checks
Confirm the imported five positive and three negative tests plus reviewer walkthrough
Independent directory discovery receipt after publication
